title: Graph-Induced Tensor Liftings for Networked SEIR Models: Dimensional Reduction and Residual Analysis
summary: Networked SEIR models describe epidemic spread within and between interacting subpopulations through contact-supported nonlinear transmission. Standard polynomial liftings based on complete ordered Kronecker tensors yield linear higher-dimensional representations, but their dimensions grow rapidly because they retain interactions absent from the transmission graph. This paper develops a graph-induced tensor lifting whose observables are selected from the effective transmission support.
